key_decisions.rationale: Read the last clause as part of the instructed reply, retaining return and immediacy; document alternative speaker scope.
key_decisions.before: If anyone asks, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord needs it and will send it back here immediately.’”
key_decisions.after: If anyone asks you why you are doing this, say, ‘The Lord needs it and will send it back here at once.’”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And if anyone says to you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord has need of it and will send it back here immediately.’”

key_decisions.rationale: Retain the difficult out-of-season explanation without rationalizing away the narrative tension.
key_decisions.before: Seeing in the distance a fig tree with leaves, he went to see whether he could find anything on it. When he reached it, he found nothing but leaves, because it was not the season for figs.
key_decisions.after: He saw a leafy fig tree in the distance and went to see whether he might find anything on it. When he reached it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And seeing from afar a fig tree having leaves, he went to see whether he might find anything on it. And coming to it, he found nothing except leaves, for it was not the season for figs.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserve the broad prohibition and through rather than supply an unstated commercial route.
key_decisions.before: He would not allow anyone to carry merchandise through the temple.
key_decisions.after: and he would not let anyone carry goods through the temple.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And he would not allow anyone to carry a vessel through the temple.

key_decisions.rationale: Retain all nations and the house/den contrast without reducing robbery to unfair prices alone.
key_decisions.before: He taught them, saying, “Is it not written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all nations’? But you have made it a den of robbers.”
key_decisions.after: As he taught them, he said, “Is it not written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all nations’? But you have made it a den of robbers.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And he was teaching and saying to them, “Is it not written, ‘My house shall be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it a den of robbers.”

key_decisions.rationale: Retain the plural departure and customary force of the source's whenever/imperfect construction.
key_decisions.before: When evening came, Jesus and his disciples went out of the city.
key_decisions.after: When evening came, Jesus and his disciples would leave the city.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And when evening came, they went out of the city.

key_decisions.rationale: Render the genitive as trust directed toward God without creating a special category of divine-quality faith.
key_decisions.before: Jesus answered them, “Have faith in God.
key_decisions.after: Jesus answered them, “Have faith in God.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And answering, Jesus said to them, “Have faith in God.

key_decisions.rationale: Retain this mountain, heart, and the present happening in the condition without softening the promise.
key_decisions.before: Truly I tell you, whoever says to this mountain, ‘Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,’ and does not doubt in their heart but trusts that what they say will happen, it will be done for them.
key_decisions.after: Truly I tell you, whoever says to this mountain, ‘Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,’ and does not doubt in their heart but believes that what they say is happening, will have it happen for them.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Truly I say to you, whoever says to this mountain, ‘Be taken up and thrown into the sea,’ and does not doubt in his heart but believes that what he says happens, it will be for him.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserve the source's already-received tense followed by future result and its explicit inference.
key_decisions.before: Therefore I tell you, whatever you pray and ask for, trust that you have received it, and it will be yours.
key_decisions.after: That is why I tell you: whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Therefore I say to you, whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.

key_decisions.rationale: Keep standing, comprehensive forgiveness, and the purpose/result relation to the Father's forgiveness.
key_decisions.before: And whenever you stand praying, forgive if you have anything against anyone, so that your Father in heaven may also forgive your trespasses.”
key_decisions.after: And whenever you stand praying, forgive anyone you have anything against, so that your Father in heaven may also forgive your offenses.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone, so that your Father who is in the heavens may also forgive you your trespasses.”

key_decisions.rationale: Preserve the explicit opening question present in the pinned source and the nested hypothetical answer.
key_decisions.before: They discussed it among themselves: “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Then why did you not trust him?’
key_decisions.after: They discussed it among themselves: “What should we say? If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask, ‘Then why did you not believe him?’
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And they were reasoning with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
